name: @assistant-ui/tap
notes: React hook engine reimplemented so hooks can run outside a React tree. Zero dependencies, 752 KB unpacked. Required peer of core and store; not intended as a direct application dependency.

build_vs_buy.effort: months; React hook semantics are subtle
build_vs_buy.rationale: Reimplementing React's hook semantics outside React is a research project, not a sprint.
